summary: At source baseline c2463001, rejected an additional bare-rival coverage theorem as insufficient novelty: the selected unpreceded potency either is not being moved or has a distinct nonprior actual mover is a direct witness-local repackaging of the existing Night elimination/forced-repair result, and adding the priority bridge makes its nonmotion follow constructively. All four root-core commitments and present motion hold together with the bare potency-priority rival, while the stronger Night commitment and global act-priority fail. Independent source/type/registration sweep found no P1/P2. Bounds: three beings and one respect, not claimed carrier-minimal. InPotency remains a shared primitive assigned by this interpretation, not a new global definition. The idle potency is not being moved at this evaluation; no permanent rest or temporal persistence follows. This certifies satisfiability of the encoding, not metaphysical possibility, premise truth or unconditional root closure. Root-premise delta: none.
